dataset: Controlled ClinVar-derived balanced 10k sample; 5,000 benign/likely benign and 5,000 pathogenic/likely pathogenic
split_definition: Exact shared stratified 80/20 split, seed 13; 8,000 train/2,000 test
exact_feature_sources: ANNOVAR/refGene functional consequence; gnomAD allele frequency and derived rarity/missingness summaries; non-predictor conservation; variant type/length; amino-acid physicochemical deltas; BLOSUM62; 86 dbNSFP prior pathogenicity/damagingness score, rank, and prediction fields
what_the_plus_means: + dbNSFP means 86 published prior-predictor fields are concatenated to the same clean variant rows; no new labels or dataset are added
limitation: High circularity risk from predictor reuse and possible source-training overlap; random balanced split is not gene-held-out or external validation.

what_the_plus_means: + SpliceAI means 12 exact-matched mechanistic splicing columns are added to mode C on the same variant IDs

dataset: Controlled ClinVar-derived balanced 10k sample; 5,000 benign/likely benign and 5,000 pathogenic/likely pathogenic

exact_feature_sources: Mode C feature sources; AlphaMissense hg38 exact-match pathogenicity score and availability flag; AlphaMissense class is excluded
what_the_plus_means: + AlphaMissense means an exact-matched expert missense score and availability flag are added to mode C; no SpliceAI or clinical labels are added
limitation: Mode C circularity risk remains; AlphaMissense is missense-only and may overlap external expert-model training evidence.

dataset: Controlled ClinVar-derived balanced 10k sample; 5,000 benign/likely benign and 5,000 pathogenic/likely pathogenic
split_definition: Exact shared stratified 80/20 split, seed 13; 8,000 train/2,000 test
exact_feature_sources: Mode C feature sources; SpliceAI DS/DP sidecar; AlphaMissense score and availability; tabular p/logit; transductive variant graph with same-gene, same-consequence, and kNN feature-similarity edges
what_the_plus_means: + GraphSAGE means a graph-derived delta corrects the logit of the 214-feature mode C + SpliceAI + AlphaMissense LightGBM; it is residual correction, not stacking
limitation: High circularity plus transductive graph/same-gene context risk; test features participate in message passing although test labels remain hidden.
